facts.claim: A-OTHR is part of NORAD modernization ($38.6B over 20 years announced June 2022) and Northern Approaches Surveillance System (NASS).

Stage 1 sites: Kawartha Lakes transmit (163 ha, 0 Thistle Trail) and Clearview Township preliminary receive (288 ha). Initial work as early as winter 2026; Stage 1 capability by end 2029; full capability anticipated 2043.
facts.source: same DND A-OTHR page; page details class 2025-12-22

facts.claim: Public consultations Stage 1: 17 Jul–15 Oct 2025 online; town halls 9–10 Sep 2025; 400+ feedback forms.

22 June 2026 DIA: Fuhr–Marles G2G Acquisition Arrangement + OTHR Rights Agreement + ITB with BAE Systems Australia; Canada committed to spend $2.5B with Australia; BAE work start 1 July 2026; IOC by Dec 2029; PM Mar 2025 program class >$6B.

arctic_othr.investigative_read: G2G partner path with explicit $2.5B Australia spend FACT. Distortion mode is partner-acceleration, not silent commercial sole-source. Siting process documented on DND A-OTHR page.

facts.claim: 27 May 2026: Government of Canada enters discussions with Saab (Sweden) as preferred supplier for Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEWC) capability.
Official backgrounder: engagement as preferred supplier does not constitute a contractual commitment; negotiation team will explore commercial, technical/military, and economic considerations.
Saab GlobalEye solution described as built on Canadian-manufactured Bombardier Global 6500.
L3Harris publicly framed as blindsided by sole-source/preferred talks bypassing formal competition (Aeris X / Global 6500 path).

globaleye.investigative_read: Strongest sole-source *signal* of the four points with a FACT government preferred-supplier announcement. Not yet a signed contract.

facts.claim: 6 July 2026: TKMS selected preferred supplier for up to 12 submarines; Hanwha Ocean = Reserve Supplier; negotiations next; contracting no later than end 2027; first four deliveries 2034.
Process: RFI Sep 2024–Feb 2025; two qualified 26 Aug 2025; proposals Mar 2026; preferred 6 Jul 2026. Fuhr: less than eight months from qualified suppliers to preferred.

submarine_competition.investigative_read: Winner freeze complete as preferred supplier (not signed contract). Compression is government-owned. Negotiation through 2027 is the next accountability surface.

cluster_synthesis_update: Lap3: GlobalEye FACT preferred supplier (May 2026); A-OTHR FACT G2G + $2.5B Australia spend + >$6B program class; CPSP FACT TKMS preferred + Hanwha reserve (6 Jul 2026) with <8-month compression; GLLE FACT EN+FR PSPC ~$800M award + open.canada DISCLOSURE_GAP confirmed under Bell Textron Canada Limited (463 rows, only 2 DND, only 2 >$5M facet) + REPORTING pause + stale DND project page.
